prior_review.preservation_note: The prior INT08/INT10/INT11 conclusions remain unchanged. Finding 008 is reclassified below as a bounded current-source invariant; finding 009 remains a mandatory report-validation requirement, not a current caller defect.

delta_findings.subject: last completed minute requirement and fixture history
evidence: runner.py:158-166 filters bars strictly before the cut, keeps the last 31, requires prior[-1].end_at == cut - MINUTE, then requires one-minute adjacency
tests/e0_source_fixtures.py:602-614 constructs exactly 32 bars: base=09:32, index 0 is 09:00 and index 31 is 09:31
delta_findings.negative_case: test_e0_runner_integration.py:151-154 removes the 09:31 bar. At the 09:32 cut it still leaves 31 contiguous old bars (09:00-09:30), so the new final-minute assertion—not the length or adjacency checks—rejects it with the expected missing-last-minute dependency.
delta_findings.legitimate_learned_calls: e0_learning_fixtures.py:217 calls e0_feature_values only for rows with contact. The retained native fixture places the learning contact at the base-2-second event, available before the 09:32 cut; VisitTracker consumes that visit, and no later 09:33 contact is produced. Thus legitimate learned feature calls use 09:32 with 09:31 as their last completed bar. The connected training and evaluation calls use the same typed day envelope and contact filter.

delta_findings.subject: typed synthetic policy evidence in INT03-F01
evidence: tests/e0_source_case_fixtures.py:245-262 policy_choice builds E0ActionValue rows only from actual contact rows and the requested signed side
Each value has exact probabilities (1,0,0), exact declared net values, decision/cut clocks, candidate/object/source/decision-set identities, horizon/expiry, and E0SyntheticNumericalEvidence

The embedded evidence binds id/model_version to digest(payload), target_version to the typed policy, fold_id to the declared control, feature_version to the actual row version and source_version to the actual row source
score_and_decide_e0 receives the actual observations.E0DecisionSet and typed values, so selection is produced through the public policy port rather than an action-string shortcut
delta_findings.scope: This is an explicit INT03 arithmetic/control policy view. It is synthetic_numeric_control evidence and is not presented as E0CommittedPredictionEvidence or used as a production learned-branch fit.

delta_findings.subject: all current 19 source cases remain mapped
delta_findings.result: No source-case method was removed, renamed out of its frozen group, or replaced by a generated receipt assertion. INT01/04/12/SCOPE remain directly delegated to their operational-case helpers.

delta_findings.subject: current retained source fixture remains receipt-bound
evidence: tests/e0_source_fixtures.py:775-791 creates NativeCoverageReceipt from the actual event tuple, using the event dataset/schema identities and raw retained rows
tests/e0_source_fixtures.py:108-119 exposes the runner day with market_state=continuous
tests/e0_source_fixtures.py:602-614 provides the full 09:00-09:31 completed-minute history needed by the 09:31/09:32 legitimate cuts

delta_findings.subject: current route vocabulary is fixed by the registered source code
delta_findings.detail: The earlier restore observation remains technically true: runner restore reconstructs FillScenario using venue_first and strict_trade_through. Current E0RunManifest.__post_init__ requires scenarios == the module-level SCENARIOS tuple, and every current E0Scenario uses that route vocabulary. Therefore this is a bounded current-source invariant, not a current INT10 incompatibility. It becomes a defect only if route fields are added to registered scenarios without persisting them in the manifest/checkpoint.

delta_findings.subject: report validators remain required
delta_findings.detail: E0NativeExecutionSource and E0ExecutionEvidence still defer full native receipt/path equivalence until rebuild/validate_replay. This remains an explicit validation contract rather than a current report-fixture gap: reporting._economic_join invokes item.__post_init__, native_source.rebuild and _compare_replay before economic completion, while INT11 supplies the typed NativeCoverageReceipt and actual VenuePath. Consumers must retain this validator call before treating standalone evidence as verified.

conclusion: The source-only delta review found no blocking defect. The new last-completed-minute gate is compatible with the retained 32-bar fixture and all legitimate learned feature calls. Current INT03 policy_choice uses typed synthetic control evidence with explicit lineage. All 19 source cases remain mapped. Prior route and report-validator observations are preserved and reclassified as a current-source invariant and a mandatory validation contract, respectively. No dynamic pass claim is made.
